Tiptap 🩰 is a rich text editor that gives you control over of your text editor. (⚠️ Tiptap -- the underlying tech of this rich text editor -- is still in beta)

[b]FEATURES[/b]
---------------

[b]Menus[/b]
Fully customizable menus
[ul]
[li]Top menu[/li]
[li]Bubble menu: highlight a word and this menu pops up.[/li]
[li]Floating menu: appears in an empty line.[/li]
[/ul]

[b]Formats[/b]
[ul]
[li]Bold, Italics, [/li]
[li]Heading (1 - 6)[/li]
[li]blockquotes[/li]
[li]lists[/li]
[li]task lists[/li]
[li]Images[/li]
[li]code blocks[/li]
[/ul]


[b]Output[/b]
[ul]
[li]HTML[/li]
[li]Plain text[/li]
[li]JSON[/li]
[li]autobind. ⚠️ not yet recommended to use in pop-ups. Use autobind where the source doesn't change.[/li]
[/ul]


[b]Keyboard shortcuts[/b]
Both for classical editor and markdown. You can set a paragraph to Heading1 either by typing ⌘ + ⌥ + 1  or by adding # at the beginning of a paragraph.


[b]Beautiful Tailwind Typography styling[/b]
The text inside the editor is styled according to TailwindCSS's Typography styles.


[b]Modern tech[/b]
Under the hood it uses the esh.sm for the latest web tech: es2015+ for speed and flexibility.
